I am a college student at Srinagar Kashmir.being a muslim majority region many Islamic organizations are working here according to their ideologies & the conditions prevailing here. Amid such situation it is natural to have conflicts between different ideologies. But the problem arises when different schools of thought start rejecting each other and go to such an extent that they call eachother KAFIR , and other ideologies as BATIL. Still they may not feel any problem for themselves ,but it does become a problem for a common man when he tries return towards the Din of Allah, or when he becomes serious about Islam and wishes to work in the way of Allah . because it is a must to join an organization to work in a coordinated and fruitfull manner . but at this moment one has to decide which organization is on truth (Islam) . I?m in a similar dilemma as which way to choose to work in an organizational setup. Probably I was fortunate to meet a pious man who reminded me of our real aim in life and helped me to motivate myself to lead an Islamic way of life . he himself belongs to jamait-e-Islami. when looking onto the good points every organization has a sizeable list on the other hand if we try to point out the bad points there also we get many. and these are used by people for criticism . the various org here are jamait-e- islami , dadul uloom Deoband, Jamait ?e- ahl-e-hahith, Tableegi jamaat , Barailvi, Tehreek-e- hurriyat and many others . the good and bad points in each of themand as such one gets confused , and con not easily find out the whole of it by self study .. In this regard I request you to help me in searching out the pure Islam Your advice is very crucial to me because it is about the most important decision of my life and on it may rest the Judgment on the day of Judgment. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 10606 Country: India Title: assalaamualaikum wa rehmatullahi wa barkatuh mufti sahab,i want to ask that how to be stable on our ibadat, & how can i improve myself for using myself for din, means i m not able to put myself for dins mehnat just because of lazyness so what can i do to improve and do the mehnat of din Question: assalaamualaikum wa rehmatullahi wa barkatuh mufti sahab,i want to ask that how to be stable on our ibadat, & how can i improve myself for using myself for din, means i m not able to put myself for dins mehnat just because of lazyness so what can i do to improve and do the mehnat of din Answer ID: 10606 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 274/248=B/1429) Seek the company of religious and pious persons. Also, study the biography of the pious personalities and recite durood as much as possible.
